purpose: Read-only vehicle media dashboard showing current playback metadata, volume, returned listening statistics, source distribution and playback history.
primaryGoal: Understand what the selected vehicle is playing and inspect returned media observations within the shared workspace range; this page does not issue playback commands.

dataSources.behavior: Enabled only with selected vehicle; standard polling; passes AbortSignal; uses existing media vehicle query key. Latest reads LiveState and projects 11 fields, returning null for missing signals.
dataSources.limits: Latest response does not provide created_at, vehicle_id or id although MediaSnapshot declares those required. Actual backend freshness enforcement and media duration signal units were not traced.

dataSources.behavior: Date bounds participate in query key; AbortSignal forwarded; safeArray selection. Handler reads Timeline and collapses consecutive equal status/title/artist/album/source tuples, assigns response-local IDs and created_at. Volume-only and elapsed-only changes do not split rows.
dataSources.limits: Returned observations are not complete listening time or uniformly sampled volume history. No pagination/full-range completeness acceptance was exercised.

dataSources.owner: Existing workspace selection, range and saved number-formatting owners
dataSources.behavior: Consumes selected vehicle and shared range, retains media-player.range key and 7d fallback. /media-player is range-enabled at web\src\lib\workspaceScope.ts:50. No duplicate selector is rendered.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Page and MediaStats independently reconstruct loading/fatal/available/retained flags from the same DataState; each panel also specifies loading/error branches inside VehicleSourceContent, whose fatal SourceContent may already replace children.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep specialist empty/loading geometry and independent sources; reuse DataState fields and existing SourceContent ownership rather than introducing another generic state wrapper. Establish which layer owns fatal recovery.

existing: CardGrid requests half-width hero/chart placements and MediaSlot provides min-w-0.
Hero artwork shrinks from 112px to 64px, track text breaks words and badges wrap.
Charts use responsive containers and stepped heights.
DataTable explicitly configures mobile cards and six field roles.

issues.detail: Desktop track and artist labels are truncated to 200px/160px with no page-supplied full-value disclosure. Long values and mobile full-field reachability depend on unexercised DataTable behavior.
issues.fix: Verify existing table full-value/detail affordances at long-label and narrow-container cases; use the existing disclosure pattern if these labels cannot be fully retrieved.

requiredChecks: Long titles, artist/source names and locale strings
Mobile six-field detail access and touch recovery targets

accessibility.status: source-inspected; keyboard, screen-reader, contrast and reduced-motion execution unverified
existing: Localized section/chart names, decorative SourceIcon aria-hidden, status text plus semantic badges.
Progress meter reports name and numeric bounds when finite elapsed and positive duration are available.
Pie legend provides source names and counts as text; history has a caption and mobile display values.

issues.detail: Volume chart explicitly opts out of a table because the series is continuous. Continuous data still needs equivalent access; the history table has six fields but is not labelled as this chart's alternative and displays volume alongside max rather than the plotted sample collection.
issues.fix: Verify current EmbeddedChart keyboard/text support. Provide an accessible table or explicit link/association to equivalent timestamp-volume data using the existing chart owner; preserve every plotted finite reading.

issues.detail: Positive sub-500ms duration rounds to durationSec=0, yielding a progressbar with equal min/max bounds. m:ss visual formatting also loses subsecond precision, as currently designed.
issues.fix: Preserve the existing display convention but validate meter bounds separately; omit invalid determinate semantics or use meaningful positive seconds for ARIA bounds.

states.loading: Per-source skeletons and PageLayout busy state exist; MediaStats supplies metric-level loading reasons but does not pass its aggregate loading prop to VehicleOperationalBrief.
states.empty: No vehicle selection, missing latest object, empty history, empty volume/source series each retain their panel. Empty known history preserves zero distinct tracks, while missing average/top source remain null.
states.error: Source-local fatal retry via VehicleSourceContent; aggregate alert exposes the first fatal source. Independent healthy panels and previously loaded payloads remain present.
states.staleOffline: Retained data is marked for refresh errors or paused refreshes. No observed media signal timestamp is displayed, and no page max-age policy is supplied.
states.partialUnknown: Finite volume readings are distinguished from missing. Missing source labels become an explicit Unknown distribution slice. Latest all-null projected object passes the truthy latest branch.

issues.detail: An all-null latest response renders No track rather than an unavailable/unknown track observation. Handler deliberately returns an 11-key object of nulls for missing signals, so !latest does not catch this condition. This risks presenting lack of evidence as a stopped/absent track.
issues.fix: Distinguish no reported title/artist from affirmative no-playback states using actual source fields; retain separate missing volume and progress messages and do not invent playback status.

issues.detail: Brief availability requires both history and latest sources even when three history metrics or the latest volume-step metric are independently usable. Its mixed period is marked unknown and VehicleOperationalBrief consequently says Not a live-state observation, although one metric is explicitly latest-source based.
issues.fix: Keep all four independent metrics visible, describe partial source availability truthfully and preserve per-metric source context. Use existing brief contracts for mixed provenance rather than claiming all measurements share one historical or live freshness.

visualIssues.detail: Five source-icon categories select fixed emerald/indigo/amber/purple/cyan-300 text colors. These are toned down rather than neon, but remain theme-independent decorative hue choices and contrast is not measured.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer neutral semantic token icons where source names already convey identity, or reuse a shared theme-aware source-category treatment. Preserve existing saved chart palette choices; do not force a palette reset.

architectureIssues.detail: Page consumes date-only start/end instead of workspace startInstant/endInstantExclusive, sends those dates to the server and re-filters using browser-local midnight. Range hook explicitly preserves rolling live/24h and configured timezone as instants; backend date-only parsing is UTC. These three range interpretations can disagree.
architectureIssues.fix: Pass the existing workspace instant bounds through the typed media history hook, and remove or align the client guard to those exact bounds. Preserve rolling/custom/DST/timezone behavior and server filtering of charts, statistics and all history.

architectureIssues.detail: One MediaSnapshot interface requires id, vehicle_id and created_at, but Latest projects media fields only, while List adds id and created_at without vehicle_id. Nullable media values are also represented as optional numbers/strings instead of explicit null. The page handles most nulls defensively, but the declared contract overstates backend guarantees.
architectureIssues.fix: Use accurate latest/history response types matching real JSON nullability. Do not fabricate timestamps, ownership or units, and keep raw media values unchanged.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature placement adapter imports the nested layout-reference module rather than the layout category barrel. It is the existing renderer, not a competing implementation.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the canonical category export if available; if not, request an owner-managed export without creating another placement hook or layout engine.

priority.reason: Workspace instant-bound mismatch and unknown-versus-no-track trust semantics precede cosmetic modernization; preserve existing independent sources and all sections.
order: Correct typed source guarantees and missing-observation semantics
Mixed-source brief provenance and chart accessibility
Measured responsive/theme validation and restrained icon treatment

requiredSharedChanges.name: Accurate media history bounds and latest/history source typing
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: History accepts startInstant/endInstantExclusive without date truncation, includes both in existing query key and passes AbortSignal. Latest and history model actual nullable fields and only metadata present in their respective responses.
dependsOn: Existing media handler ParseDateRange RFC3339 semantics
requiredSharedChanges.scope: Integration-owned source correction, not a new component.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Canonical card placement export, conditional
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Expose existing useCardPlacement only if absent; preserve size/span/className and provider behavior.
requiredSharedChanges.scope: No new hook or speculative shared renderer; verify export before assigning work.

notes: Page uses existing PageLayout, cards, chart frames, DataTable and OperationalBrief rather than parallel visual engines.
Local source icon/status mappings and duration labels are specialist helpers, not proof of an app-wide competing implementation.
Hook comment references another camelCase MediaSnapshot type, but that type was not inspected and is not declared a verified competing owner.

preservation.sourceHashScope: Exact bytes of web\src\features\vehicle-systems\pages\MediaPlayerPage.tsx at audit read; root page only, not an aggregate dependency hash.
actions: Source-local retry/refresh for latest and history; shared PageLayout query recovery remains delegated to its existing owner.
Sort six columns, value filtering, pagination and mobile cards through DataTable.
Retain tableId vehicle-systems:media-history, created_at descending default, caption and response-local row ID semantics.
No playback/vehicle commands or media mutations are present in the inspected page.
dataBehavior: Keep title, artist, album, station, source and status metadata; volume, maximum, increment and progress.
Keep four metrics: unique nonempty titles, top reported source, arithmetic mean finite returned volume rounded as before, latest volume increment.
Keep all finite chart samples, chronological order, data-derived axis maximum and existing fallback 11 scale with explicit disclosure.
Keep Unknown source bucket and source frequency counts, not invented listening duration.
Keep the current source millisecond interpretation for playback labels pending authoritative signal-unit verification; never migrate units based on field names alone.
Raw SI/wire/cache values, workspace vehicle/range, cancellation, query keys, polling, saved formatting and localization must survive.
Missing readings remain unknown, not zero or silence. Retained values remain visible after refresh failures and independent neighbors remain usable.
